summaryZh: David Kirsh 的 Interactive Cognition Lab 研究交互环境设计所需的基础认知问题，包括分布式协作、交互、协调、表征、在线学习和注意管理。页面列出增强视频、协作环境、情境感知办公室和信息架构等项目，但未明确具体研究方法。
researchQuestions: 如何提高交互环境对情境的感知能力？

evidence.quote: Interactive Cognition Lab We do basic research on the topics needed for designing interactive environments. These include studying the nature of Distributed Collaboration, Interactivity, Coordination, Human Computer Interaction, Representation, E-Learning, Attention Management and how to increase the Context Awareness of our environments.
